title: Functional Test of the Cargo Compartment Extinguishing Distribution and Metering
abstract: Functional test of the cargo compartment extinguishing distribution, using a nitrogen charge in place of the agent to confirm branch balance, metering restrictor flow and squib circuit continuity.

sections.purpose: This task tests the cargo compartment extinguishing distribution without discharging an agent bottle, and confirms the branch balance, the metering restrictor flow and the squib circuit continuity.
sections.job_setup_note: The agent bottles must be disconnected and the squibs must be disarmed before any circuit is tested. A squib fired during the continuity check will discharge the bottle into an open compartment with people in it. Use the nitrogen test rig and never substitute shop air, because moisture in the distribution line will be trapped behind the restrictors and cause corrosion.
sections.procedure: 1. Disconnect the agent bottles and fit the transit caps. WARNING: DISARM THE SQUIBS AND FIT THE SHORTING PLUGS BEFORE YOU TOUCH ANY ELECTRICAL CONNECTION. AN INADVERTENT DISCHARGE INTO AN OCCUPIED COMPARTMENT IS A SERIOUS HAZARD. 2. Fit the shorting plugs at the squib connectors. 3. Get access through the cargo lining in zones 151 and 182. 4. Connect the nitrogen test rig to the distribution inlet. CAUTION: DO NOT USE SHOP AIR IN PLACE OF NITROGEN. TRAPPED MOISTURE BEHIND THE METERING RESTRICTORS WILL CORRODE THE DISTRIBUTION LINE. 5. Pressurise the distribution to the test value and check every joint for leakage. 6. Measure the flow at each branch outlet and record the readings. 7. Compare the branch balance with the table in the instructions. 8. Check the metering restrictor HAD420992-96 for obstruction by measuring the pressure drop across it. 9. Check the actuator at FIN 598WD and the manifold at FIN 758WF for security and correct orientation. 10. Depressurise and disconnect the test rig. 11. Remove the shorting plugs one circuit at a time and do the squib continuity check with the approved low current tester. 12. Refit the shorting plugs, reconnect the agent bottles and remove the transit caps. 13. Do the flight deck discharge indication test without arming the squibs.
sections.close_out: Confirm that the shorting plugs are removed and that the agent bottles are connected and secure. Restore the cargo lining. Record the branch flow readings, the restrictor pressure drop and the continuity values on the maintenance record. Report any branch outside the balance table before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The branch balance table depends on the fuselage length.

safety_precautions: Disarm the squibs and fit the shorting plugs before any electrical work.
Disconnect the agent bottles and fit transit caps.
Use nitrogen only, never shop air.
